svg.title: Disruption and recalibration — Xiaohongshu reach and account ban
svg.desc: A Xiaohongshu post documenting organic reach and a cropped platform notice showing the off-platform traffic rule category. The account received a ban, three appeals failed, and map listings and returning customers brought some visits for a time.
svg.text: A channel that had begun to work—and the rule boundary that closed it
Notice crop shows the rule category; account identifier is not included.
After the ban, I did not rebuild the Xiaohongshu channel.
For a time, the shop’s map listing and returning customers still brought visits. I had concentrated too many functions
on my own capacity and underestimated their combined weight. The store is no longer operating.
